description: Check now. POST /api/unit-camera-status/check-now asks Tech Check (public.cos_check_now_v1, Owner or approved IT) to start the same camera checks the timer runs, unless one is already running or has just run, and returns when the results should be in. The board's Refresh uses it, then re-reads. The route reads and changes nothing itself. Three exact edits to live v26: the route and its two served-path lists.
authorization: James, 2026-11-27: 'I want to be able to click refresh and it will refresh and update for me. Can it be faster?' Running the deploy still needs his explicit go for that run, and Tech Check's cos_check_now_v1 must be applied first (tech-checks/docs/db-changes/20261127_cos_check_now.md).
